prompt: Rendered as a pencil sketch with light color wash, the scene captures a bustling subway platform. On the left, a man in a red scarf stands holding a black briefcase, his posture rigid against the tiled wall. Next to him, a woman in a yellow coat checks her silver wristwatch, her gaze fixed on the timepiece. A brown dog sits patiently beside her, tethered by a blue leash held firmly in her left hand. In the center, a teenager in a green hoodie leans against a metal pillar, eyes locked on a glowing smartphone screen. Beside the teen, an elderly man in a gray suit rests his hand on a wooden cane, looking toward the tunnel entrance. A young girl in a pink dress points excitedly at a distant train light, her finger extended toward the dark void. Her mother, wearing a blue blazer, looks down at the child with a gentle smile, adjusting the girl's white hair ribbon. To the right, a businessman in a navy tie reads a folded newspaper, ignoring the crowd around him. A street musician with a guitar case open at his feet plays a violin, bow moving across strings. A tourist in a floral shirt drops a coin into the open case, interacting with the musician. Behind them, a security guard in a dark uniform watches the platform, arms crossed over his chest. A pigeon pecks at crumbs near the tracks, oblivious to the humans. A discarded coffee cup lies on its side near the edge of the platform. A digital clock hangs above, displaying bright red numbers. There is no sunlight streaming through windows. There is no visible advertisement poster on the walls.
